summary.label: About this record
summary.hint: The conversation, its files and its history are in the thread: Files opens every file, View › Changes shows what changed, and its ⋯ holds tasks, approvals and sharing.

missing.title: You cannot see this record
missing.body: It does not exist, or it is outside what you may open.

noRight.title: You cannot read this record's conversation
noRight.body: It needs the right “{right}”. Ask an administrator of your company.

failed.title: The record could not be read
failed.body: Check the connection and try again.
